integrity: The general formulas are proved by cube-face support classification; a finite exact enumerator independently checks all nonempty proper face supports for 2 <= n <= 100. The finite replay is corroborative, not a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The formulas B1 through B5 are exact positional capacities under empty-face boundary constraints, not asserted sharp one-component knot crossing maxima. Full-text comparison with Pezzimenti--Meintel--Shabon (2025), Cubic knot mosaics, was unavailable.
title: Face-sensitive crossing capacities for spherical knot mosaics
